scripts.build: npm -w @univerify/verifier-core run build && npm -w @univerify/verifier-cli run build && npm -w web run build
scripts.contracts:deploy: dotenv -e .env -- sh -c 'cd contracts && forge script script/Deploy.s.sol:Deploy --rpc-url $RPC_URL --private-key $OWNER_PK --broadcast'
scripts.deploy:sepolia: npm run contracts:deploy && npm run sync:env:sepolia
scripts.deploy:mainnet: npm run contracts:deploy && npm run sync:env:mainnet
